newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent diesel prices track NYMEX higher.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gaaoline and diesel fuel prices tracked rising NYMEX futures on steady differentials Friday.
Spot diesel prices rode a more than two cent a gallon gain in front-month heating oil futures, and spot gasoline was up nearly 1.50 cents a gallon on higher January unleaded in midday NYMEX trade.
Some buyers were drawn into the Chicago and Group Three markets after prices eased earlier in the week on a NYMEX sell-off, traders said.
"I think there's been some bottom picking," one Group Three trader said of buying interest holding differentials steady in the face of higher futures prices.
Traders had expected ample supplies in the Midwest and scheduled late-month shipments to push spot prices lower heading into the final weeks of the year.
High sulphur diesel differentials were steady at 7.0/6.50 cents a gallon under the print in Chicago and firmed to 6.75/7.25 cents under in Group Three.
Chicago unleaded gasoline was bid 4.0 cents a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and 4.50 cents under for later deliveries, with premium 0.50 cent higher.
Group Three unleaded remained 4.25/4.0 cents a gallon under the print for prompt deliveries and was 4.50/4.25 cents under for later deliveries, with premium 1.75 cent higher.
